g.text: ToDo: Ferrite (select w/high Z at high F, low Z at low F). Try to block everything >1MHz or so.
NOTE: For the best power on/off pop performance, the amplifier should be set in the shutdown mode prior to power on/off operation (set SD low to power down the amp).
C3: Use 1uF to filter high frequency noise, or 10uF if lower frequency noise is present
